Agustin Canobbio.note: Canobbio stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Agustin Canobbio.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Brian Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Brian Rodriguez.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Darwin Nunez.note: Núñez's signature is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Darwin Nunez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Emiliano Martinez.note: Martínez's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Emiliano Martinez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Facundo Pellistri.note: Pellistri stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Facundo Pellistri.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Federico Valverde.note: Valverde's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Federico Valverde.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Federico Vinas.note: Viñas's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Federico Vinas.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Fernando Muslera.note: Watch Muslera for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
Fernando Muslera.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。

Giorgian De Arrascaeta.note: Watch Arrascaeta for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Giorgian De Arrascaeta.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Guillermo Varela.note: Varela's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Guillermo Varela.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Joaquin Piquerez.note: Piquerez's edge is delivering the ball without needing much space. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Joaquin Piquerez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jose Maria Gimenez.note: Watch Giménez for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Jose Maria Gimenez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Juan Manuel Sanabria.note: Sanabria is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Juan Manuel Sanabria.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Manuel Ugarte.note: Ugarte stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Manuel Ugarte.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mathias Olivera.note: Olivera stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Mathias Olivera.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Matias Vina.note: Viña is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Matias Vina.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Maxi Araujo.note: Watch Araújo for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Maxi Araujo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Nicolas De La Cruz.note: Cruz's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Nicolas De La Cruz.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Rodrigo Aguirre.note: Aguirre's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Rodrigo Aguirre.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Rodrigo Bentancur.note: Bentancur's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Rodrigo Bentancur.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Rodrigo Zalazar.note: Watch Zalazar for creating a better angle for the next pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Rodrigo Zalazar.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ronald Araujo.note: Araújo is defined by recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ronald Araujo.noteZh: 他靠第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Santiago Bueno.note: Watch Bueno for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Santiago Bueno.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Santiago Mele.note: Watch Mele for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Santiago Mele.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Sebastian Caceres.note: Cáceres is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Sebastian Caceres.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Sergio Rochet.note: Rochet stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Sergio Rochet.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。
